title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed at State of Play
description: Sony's latest State of Play showcases revealed a massive lineup of PS5 games and hardware, including the official GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony's Double State of Play Showcase Delivers Massive PS5 News

In a packed double-feature livestream event covered by Push Square, Sony combined a general **State of Play** showcase back-to-back with a **State of Play Japan** event. Together, these dual showcases unleashed a tidal wave of announcements for the PlayStation 5, covering everything from major trilogy finales and DLC expansions to brand-new hardware.

For the massive community eagerly awaiting *Grand Theft Auto VI* (GTA 6), the absolute standout hardware announcement of the evening was the official reveal of the **GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers**, giving fans an early taste of the physical collectibles tied to Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece.

## GTA 6 Limited Edition Controllers Confirmed for November

According to the official schedule revealed during the broadcast, the **GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers** are slated to launch on **19th November**. While the presentation kept a tight lid on extensive design breakdowns, themed DualSense controllers for generational blockbusters historically feature custom aesthetics and iconic motifs inspired by the game's universe. This release will undoubtedly be a must-have collectible for fans looking to gear up for their return to Vice City and beyond.

## A Global Roundup of Major State of Play Announcements

Aside from the GTA 6 hardware news, the back-to-back presentations delivered a staggering variety of updates across the PS5 ecosystem:

*   **Final Fantasy 7 Trilogy Finale**: The epic trilogy concludes in **April**, with a wealth of new PS5 gameplay officially showcased.
*   **Until Dawn 2**: Officially confirmed for a **January 2027** release window, arriving sooner than many expected.
*   **Ghost of Yotei**: Jin Sakai returns as a playable character in the game's 'Most Wanted' mode, alongside a proper look at the *Echoes of Sekigahara* DLC.
*   **Horror and Cinematic Openings**: Sony kicked off the mood by opening with a brand-new *Resident Evil* movie.
*   **Blockbuster Third-Party Titles**: Konami surprised everyone with a new 1920s magic-based action game for PS5, *Monster Hunter Wilds* showed off a mind-blowing expansion, *Marvel's Wolverine* dropped one final trailer ahead of launch, and *Metro 2039* secured a 4th February 2027 release date.

## Editor's Take

Sony's decision to drop the GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers alongside a powerhouse software lineup highlights a strong hardware strategy moving into the holiday season. Setting the controller release for 19th November positions PlayStation perfectly for the frenzy surrounding Rockstar's upcoming title. Between major game dates and collector hardware, the PS5 lineup through 2027 looks exceptionally strong.
